title: Rehabbed Pasig Boulevard-C5 Flyover, C5 Boni Serrano Flyover to reopen Monday night
summary: The Pasig Blvd-C5 Flyover and C5 Boni Serrano Flyover will be reopened to the public on Monday night, November 2, a day earlier than originally planned.
